note: ČSOB's Plus Konto, its everyday current account, is free for everyone. Read again 2026-10-30: withdrawals by debit card at ČSOB's own machines in the Czech Republic are included free. The bank's savings account is advertised at "up to 3.8%", a ceiling not a rate, so it isn't written. Not stated on this page: overdraft, another bank's machines, transfers, abroad, interest on the account, what opening asks.
